verses.1:
This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.
 The Japhethites
verses.2:
The sons of Japheth:
 Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.3:
The sons of Gomer:
 Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.4:
And the sons of Javan:
 Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites. + 10:4 SP and some MT manuscripts (see also LXX and 1 Chronicles 1:7|1CH 1:7 ); most MT manuscripts Dodanites
verses.5:
From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.
 The Hamites
verses.6:
The sons of Ham:
 Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.7:
The sons of Cush:
 Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, + 10:7 Sabtah is a variant of Sabta ; see 1 Chronicles 1:9|1CH 1:9 . Raamah, and Sabteca.
 And the sons of Raamah:
 Sheba and Dedan.
verses.8: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one + 10:8 Or who established himself as a mighty warrior or who became the first fearless leader on the earth.
verses.9: He was a mighty hunter before + 10:9 Or in defiance of ; twice in this verse the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”
verses.10: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar. + 10:10 That is, Babylonia
verses.11: From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,
verses.12: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.
verses.13: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
verses.14: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites. + 10:14 Some translators adjust the Hebrew word order to the Casluhites, and the Caphtorites (from whom the Philistines came) ; see also Jeremiah 47:4|JER 47:4 and Amos 9:7.
verses.15: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, + 10:15 Or of the Sidonians, the foremost and of the Hittites,
verses.16: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
verses.17: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
verses.18:
the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
 Later the Canaanite clans were scattered,
verses.19: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
verses.20:
These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
 The Semites
verses.21: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; + 10:21 Or Shem, whose older brother was Japheth Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.
verses.22:
The sons of Shem:
 Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.23:
The sons of Aram:
 Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash. + 10:23 Hebrew; LXX and 1 Chronicles 1:17|1CH 1:17 Meshech
verses.24: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, + 10:24 Hebrew; LXX (see also Luke 3:35–36|LUK 3:35-36 ) And Arphaxad was the father of Cainan, and Cainan was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
verses.25: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, + 10:25 Peleg means division . because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
verses.26: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.29: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
verses.30: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
verses.31: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
verses.32: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their generations and nations. From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
